frequency_question: How often is a nominated executive official confirmed by the Senate within a comparable short window of final legislative action?
membership_rule: Includes formal presidential nominations for cabinet and major independent/executive agency directorships (like FDA, CDC, EPA) that reached the Senate floor or faced a terminal deadline. Excludes minor regional appointments.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named major FDA nominations since 1990; believed to represent all standard executive agency confirmations reaching this final procedural stage.
known_gaps: Excludes withdrawals that occurred very early before reaching active floor consideration phases.
validity_reason: Senate confirmation procedures for health agency heads remain stable over multi-decade periods barring major filibuster rule changes.
